title: Monsters, Inc. Boo in Monstropolis.
lines: Do you know what is behind the door of your wardrobe?
I'll tell you a little secret.
Behind every wardrobe door there is another world.
A world full of monsters!
That world is called Monstropolis.
Thousands of monsters live in Monstropolis.
Big monsters, small monsters, hairy monsters, slimy monsters, monsters with tentacles and monsters with ten arms.
They go to work, they drink coffee and they read the newspaper, just like us.
And two best friends live in Monstropolis.
The first is Sulley.
Sulley is big, very big, and very friendly.
He has little horns on his head and a thick, soft coat of fur.
And what colour is that fur?
Blue!
Light blue, with purple spots.
Roar!
goes Sulley, when he roars.
The second is Mike.
Mike is small and green and round like a ball, with two thin arms and two thin legs.
And Mike has only one eye!
One big eye, right in the middle of his face.
When he winks, he just closes his whole eye.
Blink!
Hee hee hee!
Mike is very funny.
He talks all the time and he loves telling jokes.
Sulley and Mike work together at a big factory.
It's called Monsters, Inc.
And do you know what they do there?
They make energy for the lamps and cars of Monstropolis.
And they get that energy from children!
There are thousands of doors in the factory.
Each door goes to a child's bedroom.
At night the monsters have to go through those doors and scare the children.
Boo!
And when a child screams, Aaaah!
, that scream is caught in a big yellow bottle.
That is the energy.
But the funny thing is: the monsters are very scared of children themselves!
They think children are poisonous.
If a monster has a child's sock on its back, men in yellow suits come.
Code two-three-one-two!
And they shave the monster completely bald.
Hee hee hee!
One evening Sulley is alone in the factory.
He sees a door that is still open.
And then something steps through the door.
Something small.
A little human girl!
She has two pigtails and pink pyjamas.
Aaaah!
shouts Sulley.
He is very scared.
But the girl isn't scared at all.
She laughs.
Kitty!
she calls to Sulley.
She calls him Kitty, because he looks like a big cat.
Sulley puts her in a bag and walks to Mike.
Mike is scared too.
A child!
A child!
They hide her at home.
They call her Boo.
Boo is very sweet.
She draws, she plays hide-and-seek, and she eats.
She laughs really loudly.
Hee hee hee!
And when Boo laughs, something strange happens.
All the lamps in the house shine brighter!
They flicker and flash.
And some lamps even explode.
Pop!
Sulley starts to love Boo very much.
And Boo loves Sulley too.
She doesn't want to leave him anymore.
But there is a mean monster in the factory.
His name is Randall.
He is purple, has lots and lots of legs and can turn invisible, like a chameleon.
Ssssss.
He wants to catch Boo.
He has built a nasty machine.
Sulley and Mike must save Boo.
They run through the factory.
They jump onto doors that hang on long rails and move very fast.
Whoosh!
Whoosh!
Through thousands of doors, through bedrooms all over the world.
In the end they throw Randall through a door to a land far, far away, and he never comes back.
Bye bye, Randall!
And then they discover something amazing.
Children's laughter gives much more energy than screaming.
A hundred times more!
Laughing is the strongest thing there is!
So from now on the monsters do something different.
They don't scare the children anymore.
They make the children laugh!
Mike tells jokes.
He does silly dances.
He falls on his face on purpose.
Plop!
And all the children laugh.
Ha ha ha!
The yellow bottles fill up, fuller than ever.
And Boo?
Sulley brought her safely back to her bed.
He tucked her in and gave her a hug.
Bye, Boo.
And later, one day, he opened her door again.
Kitty!
called Boo.
And Sulley smiled his very biggest smile.
